14517.name: High Priestess Jeklik
notes: The bat riders' fire is a game object (spell 19629 summons 177764), so it shows as a trap rather than a spell target.

14599.name: High Priest Thekal
notes: A dead high priest is resurrected after seven seconds unless the other two are dead too; all three must die inside one window.

14515.name: High Priestess Arlokk
notes: Arlokk vanishes for half a minute and returns as a panther; while gone she leaves the mob list.

11382.name: Bloodlord Mandokir
notes: Gaze: the watched player must not move or act; a violation is a Decapitate. Player reports say damage-over-time ticks do not count.

11380.name: Jin'do the Hexxer
notes: Jin'do needs at least two players on his threat list or he resets.

14834.name: Hakkar
notes: Each Aspect is cast only while that high priest is alive; the panel cannot see which priests are dead.

10184.name: Onyxia
notes: Deep Breath is one of eight directional breath spells chosen from aMoveData; it has no timer so the panel shows no next window.
Version 1.18.1 adds a second dragon and Hatchers that are not in this script; they show only as mobs that carry a summoner.

15263.name: The Prophet Skeram
notes: Skeram splits at 75, 50 and 25 percent into himself and two images; the images have 10, 20 and then 50 percent of his health.
Earth Shock is cast only while his victim is out of melee reach; Arcane Explosion only while more players than allowed stand in melee reach.

15516.name: Battleguard Sartura
notes: The next Whirlwind timer starts when the 15 second Whirlwind ends; she goes berserk 10 minutes after the pull.

15510.name: Fankriss the Unyielding
notes: Entangle: three webs, each on a random player, inside a 45 second rotation; hatchlings spawn at the web the player was sent to.
Spawn of Fankriss: the first comes 20-30 s after the pull; each wave is 1-3 spawns 4-8 s apart, the next wave 18-37 s later; each spawn enrages after 15, 20 or 25 s.

15276.name: Emperor Vek'lor
notes: Vek'lor takes no physical damage and Vek'nilash no spell damage; both teleport to swap places every 30-40 s.

15589.name: Eye of C'Thun
notes: The first three Eye Beams go to the puller, then to random targets; Dark Glare starts 45 s after the beam phase begins and lasts 38 s, and the next beam phase follows 1 s after it ends.

15727.name: C'Thun
notes: Phase 2: the first stomach grab comes 18 s minus the 3.25 s grab after he emerges, then every 10 s; killing both Flesh Tentacles in the stomach weakens him for 45 s.

15348.name: Kurinnaxx
notes: First Mortal Wound at 8-10 s, Wide Slash at 10-15 s and Thrash at 1-5 s after the pull. Sand Trap is game object 180647 under a random attacker 7 s after the pull and then every 5.1-7 s; it despawns after 5 s and casts its own 25656.

15340.name: Moam
notes: Arcane Eruption has no timer: it is cast when his mana reaches 100% and at the end of a stone form, and knocks players back. Energize first comes 90 s after the pull; while the aura is up the timer does not tick, so the next Energize is 90 s after stone form ends. The three mana fiends are summoned by the script when Energize starts and despawn 10 s out of combat.

15370.name: Buru the Gorger
notes: Breaking an egg within 5 yd of Buru stops him, casts Creature Special and picks a new random target with a full threat reset; the six eggs respawn 120 s after they die and the remaining ones are killed when he transforms.

At 20% he roots for 6 s, transforms (aura 24721) and removes Thorns; the first Creeping Plague comes 12 s after phase 2 starts (6 s after the 6 s transform completes), then every 6 s. His run speed starts at 50% and Gathering Speed stacks every 9 s in phase 1.

15369.name: Ayamiss the Hunter
notes: At 70% or less she lands, melees and wipes every player's threat; she starts on the ground and rises 20 yd 5 s after the pull. Twenty swarmers spawn every 60 s.

Stinger Spray has one timer with two windows: first at 10 s, then every 15-20 s in phase 1 and every 6-12 s in phase 2. Lash first comes 15 s and Thrash 10 s after phase 2 starts. Paralyze stuns a random player and the larva drags them to the altar; if it feeds, a hornet spawns and the player dies. The victim's threat is restored 10 s after the teleport unless phase 2 began first.

15339.name: Ossirian the Unscarred
notes: Strength of Ossirian is up at the pull; a crystal weakness removes it and he recasts it 45 s after the hit. Five weakness auras (25177/25178/25180/25181/25183) are cast by the crystal trigger, not by him.

Enveloping Winds clears the target's threat while the aura lasts and puts it back when it ends; his run speed ramps from 100% to 200% over the first 10 s. Sand Vortexes are unselectable and cast Sandstorm on themselves.

12118.name: Lucifron
notes: The first casts and the repeats are Seconds(10), Seconds(20), Seconds(6), Seconds(20), Seconds(15) and Seconds(6), which are not millisecond literals; the timer columns are 0.

11982.name: Magmadar
notes: Lava Bomb 19411 and 20474 only spawn game object 177704 through dummy spells 20494/20495; the patch is a game object, not a spell.

12057.name: Garr
notes: The Firesworn cast Immolate 15733, Thrash 8876 and Separation Anxiety 23492 themselves; on death they explode for 19497, or 20483 when Garr's 20482 forces the explosion.

12056.name: Baron Geddon
notes: Inferno roots him and ticks 19698 every second for nine ticks, 500 damage rising to 2500; below 5 percent Armageddon stops the fight AI.

11988.name: Golemagg the Incinerator
notes: Pyroblast's repeat is (3 + rand() % 4) seconds, not a literal; the Core Ragers cannot be killed while Golemagg lives and cast Mangle 19820 and Thrash 3391 themselves.

12018.name: Majordomo Executus
notes: One shared 30 s timer casts Magic Reflection 20619 or Damage Reflection 21075 at random (`rand() % 2`); Teleport 20618 runs on two independent timers (one on his current victim and one on a random other attacker); each fires first at 10000 + rand() % 20000 and then every 20000 + rand() % 10000; every teleport resets his threat (DoResetThreat); the Ragnaros event spells 19774 / 20568 / 19773 are gossip-event casts.

11502.name: Ragnaros
notes: Submerge starts 3*MINUTE after the pull and lasts 1.5*MINUTE; Lava Bursts are game objects 178088 and the Sons are summoned without a spell; Lava Shield 21857 comes from creature_template_addon; Intense Heat 21155 is cast by the Flame of Ragnaros trigger.

65020.name: Basalthar
notes: Its script has no cast; creature_spells 165020 lists Molten Bulwark 47375 every 30 s, Wide Backhand 47373 every 14 s and Crushing Slam 47374 every 16 s (seconds in that table, so the timer columns are 0). The twins share damage and healing and die together.

52145.name: Incindis
notes: Fire Nova 42037 is cast 1 s after each Quaking Stomp, not on a pull timer; the eggs hatch through their own AI (42042/42044) and Quaking Stomp is capped to one target by the spell script.

57642.name: Sorcerer-Thane Thaurissan
notes: Rune of Detonation and Rune of Combustion alternate on one shared 20 s timer, Detonation first (boss_thane.cpp:86, 205-223); Rune of Power 52724/52729 is recast at 75, 50 and 25 percent and its zones are first extended 7 s after the cast and then every 2 s for as long as the fight lasts (DynamicObject::Delay); the image casts Arcane Rupture and Arcane Barrage itself.

12435.name: Razorgore the Untamed
notes: The egg phase ends when all 30 eggs are destroyed; that is DATA_EGG and not a health or aura rule, so the panel cannot show a phase-2 label for him.

The first Orb of Domination wave comes 45 s after the pull, then every 15 s; a Legionnaire or Mage has a 50 percent chance to spawn a second copy at the same corner; the wave stops at 12 dragonspawn and 40 orcs.
Failing the egg phase kills every player with Explosion 20038.
War Stomp also removes 30 percent of the threat of every player it hits.
Razorgore has 225000 health while possessed and 450000 after the orb is released.
The Orb of Domination trigger channels Possess 19832 on Razorgore; the player using the orb controls him.
Summon Player fires only while Razorgore cannot path to his victim; it teleports that player to him.

13020.name: Vaelastrasz the Corrupt
notes: Burning Adrenaline has two independent timers: one every 15 s on a random living mana user and one every 45 s on the current tank; the player casts it on themself so the cast has a player as its caster; it cannot be dispelled.
The Burning Adrenaline explosion 23478 and its instakill 23644 are declared in the script but never cast in this core; only 23620 is applied.
Essence of the Red is cast when the fight starts and lasts 3 minutes: 500 mana, 50 energy and 20 rage per second.
The intro is a gossip event: Nefarius banishes Vael with 16404 and applies Corruption 23642 for 24 s before Vael turns hostile.
Vael starts the fight at 30 percent health.

12017.name: Broodlord Lashlayer
notes: Knock Away's first timer is a random 20-25 s so it is not in the timer columns; each hit knocks the target back and halves its threat.
While engaged he disables the four trash types in his room (12459 13996 12457 12461) and re-enables them on death or evade.

11983.name: Firemaw
notes: Wing Buffet removes 50 percent of the threat of every player it hits.
Thrash is not on a timer: every attack while he is casting a non-melee spell has a 34 percent chance to add extra attacks.
Flame Buffet is an area at the caster rather than a single-target debuff.

14601.name: Ebonroc
notes: Wing Buffet removes 50 percent of the threat of every player it hits.
Shadow of Ebonroc is only cast when the target does not already have it; it procs 23394 when the target is hit.
Thrash is not on a timer: each attack has a 33 percent chance to add extra attacks.

11981.name: Flamegor
notes: Frenzy (23342) periodically triggers Fire Nova 23462 from its own aura.
Wing Buffet removes 50 percent of the threat of every player it hits.
Thrash is not on a timer: each attack has a 33 percent chance to add extra attacks.

14020.name: Chromaggus
notes: Shimmer starts at 0 and repeats every 20 s; it removes the old vulnerability and applies one of the five Elemental Shields at random.
Two of the five breaths are chosen for the lockout; breath one fires 30 s after the pull and then every 60 s; breath two fires 60 s after the pull and then every 60 s.
Every 7.5 s one affliction is picked at random and applied 11-15 times to random targets; a player carrying all five is mutated.
Chromatic Mutation (23174) with 23175 and 23177 gives the player 500 percent damage, 10000 health and 1000 percent healing.
A player with Brood Affliction: Red who dies heals Chromaggus for 150000; a mutated player's death does the same.
He enrages at 20 percent health.

10162.name: Lord Victor Nefarius
notes: The event starts from gossip: two yells 7 s and 4 s apart; then he casts Nefarius's Barrier and turns hostile.
Two drakonid types are chosen for the lockout; two spawn every 6-7 s and a chromatic pair comes at 7-9 s then every 35 s until 42 drakes are dead.
Shadowblink smokes for 1 s and then teleports next to a random target; the next blink is 20-25 s later and resets the shadow bolt timer to 3-6 s.
The add waves are direct SummonCreature calls; no summon spell exists for them.
Mind control restores the victim's threat when the aura ends.
The waves stop at 42 drakes; Nefarian spawns at 40.

11583.name: Nefarian
notes: Nefarian is summoned when 40 drakonids are dead; he starts flying and there is no 10 s landing timer: a 100 ms transition tick starts the flight, then he lands and pauses for 1000 ms before he fights on the ground.
Paralyze teleports the called rogue to Nefarian and roots them.
One random class is called every 25-35 s including the first; a class with no living player is dropped and retried on the next tick.

The class calls are class-wide: every living player of the called class receives the effect. Only the paladin, hunter and warlock calls are casts (each player casts it on themself) and leave a cast event; the warrior, rogue, priest, shaman, mage and druid calls apply the aura directly with AddAura and leave no cast event. Only Wild Polymorph picks a random secondary target.

The first Shadow Flame is 18-25 s; the first Bellowing Roar is 25-30 s; the first Cleave is 7-10 s; those first values are random and stay out of the timer columns. The first Veil of Shadow is 15 s and the first Tail Lash 10 s; every timer counts from landing, not from the pull.
Every 5 s each called mage polymorphs a random unit from Nefarian's threat list within 60 yd of the mage: never a totem and never a unit already polymorphed; the mage is the caster.

The corrupted totems' own effects are cast by the totem adds, not by Nefarian: Stoneskin 10405, Healing Stream 10461, Windfury Totem Passive 10612 and Fire Nova 11311 triggering 11307. The schema has no add-caster row, so they are listed here; the shaman's Corrupted Totems 23425 picks one of the four totems at random.

Bone Constructs rise from every Drakonid Bones game object (179804) within 200 yd when he drops below 20 percent. This is a note and not a phase: the panel's phases are exclusive, and he keeps his ground abilities below 20 percent.
The initial Shadow Flame 22992 is a self aura cast in transition stage 0 when he starts flying; the 18-25 s Shadow Flame timer only starts once he has landed.

15956.name: Anub'Rekhan
notes: Impale and Locust Swarm timers are random ranges: Impale first at 12-18 s then every 12-18 s; Locust Swarm first at 80-120 s then every 90-110 s. Impale pauses while Locust Swarm is up or he is casting. Impale is a 15 degree front cone of 45 yd.
Each Locust Swarm summons one Crypt Guard at the third spawn point. A dead guard explodes into 10 Corpse Scarabs 20-80 s after it dies; every player death adds 5 more from the instance script.
Crypt Guards: Web every 12 s and reset threat; Cleave every 6 s; Acid Spit every 5 s; Enrage at 50%.

15953.name: Grand Widow Faerlina
notes: Enrage is skipped while she has Widow's Embrace. A worshipper death casts 28732 on itself and removes the enrage; the enrage timer is then at least 30 s.
Poison Bolt Volley hits up to 10 targets; she starts it at 8 s and repeats every 10-12 s.
Two followers and four worshippers stand in the room; killing a worshipper sacrifices it to silence her.

15952.name: Maexxna
notes: Web Wrap takes up to three players that are not the tank; they are knocked to a web and the player casts 28622 on itself 2 s later; the Web Wrap creature appears 3 s after that cast.
Web Spray hits everyone in the room except players already wrapped; it stuns. Enrage is the only health threshold and stops nothing.

15954.name: Noth the Plaguebringer
notes: Blink picks one of 29208-29211 at random every 30-40 s and casts Cripple on players at the old spot.

Balcony: first teleport at 90 s; later ones 110 s after the first ground phase and 180 s after the second. A balcony lasts 70, 95 then 120 s; adds spawn 5-7 s in and once more 25, 44 then 57 s later. On it he is immune and stops Curse, Blink and warrior summons. The panel cannot see the phase change: 29230 is a passive aura the module does not send; a module change (send passive auras that have a duration) would enable a phase row.
Curse of the Plaguebringer first at 8-12 s then every 50-60 s; it also hits the 20 closest players to the victim. It is a curse and dispellable.

Warrior summon 29247 is one of 29247/29248/29249 cast together at 10 s then every 30 s; each summons one warrior at a different point. Champion and guardian spells are ten and four location variants led by 29217 and 29226.

15936.name: Heigan the Unclean
notes: Decrepit Fever first at 30 s then every 20-25 s; it is re-armed 5 s after a dance ends.

Dance starts 90 s after the pull and 90 s after the previous dance ends; it lasts 45 s. He stops melee and his ground abilities and the room erupts. Plague Clouds (533002) spawn at the dance start, cast 29350 and live 45 s.
Eruption is cast by summoned fissures: first at 15 s then every 10 s on the ground; first at 4 s then every 3 s in the dance.
Mana Burn repeats every 3 s while a mana user is within 28 yd and retries every 1 s otherwise.
Teleport Self 30211 is also sent for player ports with the player as caster: 40 s after the pull then 18 s and 48 s after a dance ends.

16011.name: Loatheb
notes: Poison Aura first at 5 s then every 12 s; Remove Curse first at 5 s then every 30 s.

Corrupted Mind first at 5 s then every 10 s. It triggers one per-class debuff: 29194 for priest and druid, 29196 for paladin and 29198 for shaman; 29185 is named in the comment but not cast by the script.
Inevitable Doom first at 2 min then every 30 s; after the seventh it is every 15 s.
Spores spawn every 13 s and apply Fungal Bloom 29232 to nearby players (EventAI row 1628601); the raid gathers on a spore for the buff.
Eye Stalks use 20 positions around the room: up 15-20 s then down 1-5 s; a killed stalk waits 1-5 s plus 20 s. They cast Mind Flay within 35 yd.

16061.name: Instructor Razuvious
notes: Unbalancing Strike first at 30 s then every 30 s; Disrupting Shout first at 15 s then every 25 s.
Four understudies stand around him; mind-control one to tank. When mind control ends the add casts Mind Exhaustion on itself and resets its threat.
Disrupting Shout burns mana; the shout is physical and a Blessing of Protection or invisibility avoids it.

16060.name: Gothik the Harvester
notes: Wave table: 18 waves with 5-20 s between them; the 50 s last gap runs before he teleports down. Each wave summons four trainees, two deathknights or one rider on the living side. The panel cannot see the phase change: 29230 is a passive aura the module does not send; a module change (send passive auras that have a duration) would enable a phase row.
Each dead living-side add sends a spectral version to the other side through the anchor triggers; gates open at 30% or after four teleports or when one side has one player left.
Shadow Bolt and Harvest Soul are ground-phase only; teleporting stops once the gates open.

16065.name: Lady Blaumeux
notes: Blaumeux casts one Void Zone first at 15 s then every 12 s at a random player: a fake zone 15904 appears at the target's feet and spawns the real 16697 after 1 s; it lasts 90 s.

The mark lands first at 20 s then every 12 s on every player within its radius; each cast also cuts all threat by 50%. Stacks of 2/3/4 deal 250/1000/3000 and 5 or more deal 1000 per stack. Shield Wall is also used again at 20% if the 30 s cooldown has expired.

16062.name: Highlord Mograine
notes: Righteous Fire is a self aura that burns melee attackers through 28882. The mark and Shield Wall behave as on Blaumeux.
On death he summons his Spirit (16775); the spirit keeps the mark timer and cannot melee.

16064.name: Thane Korth'azz
notes: Meteor damage is split among everyone in its area; the first comes 20 s after the pull then every 12-15 s. The mark and Shield Wall behave as on Blaumeux.
On death he summons his Spirit (16778); the spirit keeps the mark timer and cannot melee. No berserk is cast: 26662 is defined but never used in this file.

16063.name: Sir Zeliek
notes: Holy Wrath chains to nearby players; the first comes 20 s after the pull then every 10-14 s. The mark and Shield Wall behave as on Blaumeux.
On death he summons his Spirit (16777); the spirit keeps the mark timer and cannot melee.

16028.name: Patchwerk
notes: Hateful Strike every 1.2 s targets the highest-health player among the top four threat in melee; the current tank is skipped while other players are in melee and is used only when nobody else is eligible. Each hit adds 500 threat to every player it considered. After three failed strikes he summons a soaker closer.
Berserk at 7 min; Slime Bolt starts 30 s later and repeats every 5 s to stop kiting.

15931.name: Grobbulus
notes: Mutating Injection first at 12 s; it repeats every 7-13 s above 30% health and every 3-7 s at or below 30%. Removing it by dispel or expiry explodes 28206 and leaves a poison cloud 28240.

Slime Spray first at 20-30 s then every 30-35 s and it spawns a Fallout Slime at every player it hits. Poison Cloud first at 16 s then every 16 s; Slime Stream only fires while his victim is out of melee range.
Berserk at 12 min. Poison Cloud is a summoned Grobbulus Cloud (16363) that grows and casts 28241 every second.
On Turtle a disease-dispel bug makes the puddles spawn away from the dispelled player.

15932.name: Gluth
notes: Zombies: one every 6 s from one of three points; after a Decimate the next summon waits 15 s and then three spawn at once.
Gluth eats any Zombie Chow within 10 yd every 3 s: he kills it and heals 5% of maximum health.
Decimate sets every player to 5% health and is followed by 28375 on each; healers must top the raid before the next Decimate.

15928.name: Thaddius
notes: Phase 1 is Stalagg and Feugen. Each fakes death at 0 and revives after 5 s unless both are dead; both dead starts a 15 s transition to Thaddius.
War Stomp 15-20 s on both; Static Field every 6 s (Feugen); Power Surge every 25-30 s (Stalagg); Magnetic Pull every 20.5 s swaps tanks and threat.

Polarity Shift first at 10 s then every 30 s; 3 s later every living player is split into halves and casts Positive Charge 28059 or Negative Charge 28084 on itself. Same-charge players within 13 yd buff each other through 29659 and 29660 applied by the aura script.
Ball Lightning only while the tank is out of melee: first 1 s then every 1.5 s. Chain Lightning every 5-7 s. Berserk 5 min after phase 2 starts.

15989.name: Sapphiron
notes: Ground phase: Life Drain first at 12 s then every 24 s; Cleave first at 5 s then every 5-10 s; Tail Sweep first at 12 s then every 7-10 s. After a landing Life Drain is 3 s and Blizzard 1 s.
Air phase: five icebolts 3.5 s apart after the first at 6 s; then Frost Breath (1.5 s dummy + 0.5 s) and a 7 s cast; he lands 7 s after the breath.

Icebolt freezes the target in an ice block (game object 181247) for 30 s. Blizzard is a summoned creature whose 28534 aura triggers 28547 every 3 s; each creature lives 30 s and keeps ticking into the air phase, and a new one is placed every 20 s.
Life Drain drains 7-10 random players and heals Sapphiron; Frost Aura is re-applied whenever missing.

15990.name: Kel'Thuzad
notes: Phase 1: 120 skeletons, 14 abominations and 14 soul weavers over about 5:20; he is immune and unselectable. Phase 2 starts 15 s after the 5:20 intro.
At 40% he adds five Guardians of Icecrown one every 7 s; more than three shackled guardians free themselves.
Chains mind-controls players (aura 28410) and resets threat; first at 60 s then every 60-90 s.

Phase 2 opening timers: Frostbolt 10 s then every 5-20 s; Shadow Fissure 14 s then 10-30 s; Detonate Mana 20 s then 20-30 s; Frostbolt Volley 30 s then 15-45 s; Frost Blast 50 s then 30-60 s; Chains 60 s then 60-90 s. Berserk after 19 min then every 5 min.
Guardian Blood Tap 28470 is applied by AddAura every 18 s rather than cast; on a player death all guardians gain a stack.

15511.name: Lord Kri
notes: When any of the three dies the survivors sprint to the corpse, devour it for 4 s, then heal to full and reset threat.
A bug that leaves the room (y below 2060 and x above -8600) evades and respawns all three.
Thrash is first cast 4-7 s after the pull; Cleave 4-8 s; Toxic Volley 8-10 s.
On death Kri casts Toxic Vapors at his corpse; the script casts 25786 directly and does not spawn the 15933 Poison Cloud trigger.

15543.name: Princess Yauj
notes: When any of the three dies the survivors sprint to the corpse, devour it for 4 s, then heal to full and reset threat.
A bug that leaves the room (y below 2060 and x above -8600) evades and respawns all three.
Fear is first cast 10-20 s after the pull; Great Heal 10-20 s; Ravage 4-9 s.
Fear also resets Yauj's threat. Great Heal is a 2 s interruptible cast: on herself below 93 percent, otherwise on the lowest-health friendly within 100 yd.
Ten Yauj Brood spawn on death 10-40 yd around her and despawn 10 s after combat ends.

15544.name: Vem
notes: When any of the three dies the survivors sprint to the corpse, devour it for 4 s, then heal to full and reset threat.
A bug that leaves the room (y below 2060 and x above -8600) evades and respawns all three.
Charge is first cast 10-15 s after the pull; Knock Away 15-20 s; Knockdown 5-8 s.
Charge only picks targets outside melee reach. Knock Away cuts 80 percent of the current victim's threat. Knockdown is only rolled while a player is in melee range.
When Vem dies the two surviving bugs gain Vengeance.

15299.name: Viscidus
notes: Frost hits build up: 100 hits slow him, 150 slow him more, 200 freeze him; after the freeze only physical hits count, 50 crack, 100 shatter, 150 shatter him apart.
The freeze lasts 15 s; if 150 physical hits do not land in that window the aura expires and he thaws back to normal.
Each glob killed costs him 5 percent health; each glob that reaches him heals him and makes him grow; when none are left he teleports to the room centre, resets threat and turns normal again.
Damage cannot take him below 1 percent health; he dies only when he shatters below 5 percent.
Toxin: a random player in line of sight gets an invisible trigger at their feet; 3 s later it casts Toxin Cloud and keeps recasting it from its aura; the trigger lasts 180 s.
The first Poison Shock comes 7-12 s after the pull, Poison Bolt Volley 10-15 s, Toxin 30-40 s.
Poison Shock is a 120 degree front cone of 15 yd (spell_template target 24, radius 18) but it is instant, so the panel draws no shape for it.
Membrane of Viscidus is on from the pull; Frost Weakness is the aura the slow counters run on.

15517.name: Ouro
notes: Ouro submerges 90 s after the pull and after every emerge; if he is busy casting he retries, and he also submerges after 3 s with no melee target (10 s grace after emerging). He stays under 30 s.
While submerged (30 s) Ouro is invisible and leaves the panel for the whole time; the dirt mounds and the scarabs they release are the signal.

While submerged he summons five dirt mounds and one trigger that follows a random player; Sweep and Sand Blast stop until he emerges; on emerge he teleports to the trigger, casts Birth and Ground Rupture hits every threat-list unit within 20 yd.
A dirt mound lives 30 s, then casts Summon Ouro Scarabs and despawns; a scarab despawns after 45 s.

At 20 percent Ouro enrages: the 10 s mound timer starts then, he keeps summoning one mound every 10 s and throws Boulder at random targets while the tank is out of melee reach, and he stops submerging.
Sand Blast is a 90 degree front cone of 40 yd.
Sand Blast is aimed at the top-aggro player and every player it hits loses 100 percent of their threat.
The first Sweep comes 30-40 s after the pull and the first Sand Blast 30-45 s; after every emerge Sweep re-arms at 15 s and Sand Blast at 12-17 s.

61221.name: Brood Queen Araxxna
notes: Brood Venom Volley comes first at 9-11 s and then every 9-12 s. Eggs come 30 s after the pull and then every 28-34 s; each egg kills itself after 20 s and leaves one random spider (61206, 61207 or 61209).

61222.name: Lord Blackwald II
notes: Reaver Storm comes first at 6-11 s and then every 6-12 s. Blackwalds Boon comes 20 s after the pull and every 22 s, but only when both the boon and the triggered Blackwalds Blessing land; the Blessing shares that timer. Call for Help comes 31 s after the pull and then every 44-51 s, spawning one random guard.
The boss is summoned in the entrance hall when the Dark Rider Champion (61204) dies; the champion's two apprentices (61203) belong to that trash pull, not to his fight.

61224.name: Grizikil
notes: Grellkin Fireball comes first 2 s after the pull and then every 4-6 s; spell_template gives it preventionType 0, so it cannot be kicked. Rain of Fire comes 15 s after the pull and then every 11-14 s; it is a 20 yd ground area. Every Grellkin within 190 yd joins at the pull, with no cast or timer.
At 50 percent he only yells; no ability changes.

61223.name: Clawlord Howlfang
notes: Terrifying Presence is re-applied every second. Slavering Bite comes first at 8-10 s and then every 8-11 s, only on a player in melee range. At 50 percent he only yells; at 30 percent he frenzies once.

61225.name: Moroes
notes: Glittering Dust drops 100 percent of the tank's threat and moves him to the second-highest player: the tank swap is the real mechanic. It comes first at 20-26 s and then every 20-26 s.

Shuffle Kick comes first at 7-13 s and then every 7-13 s above 50 percent; below 50 percent it re-arms at 9-15 s. The same timer and target also get Agonizing Concussion, and the kick knocks the target back.

Below 50 percent Shadow Blast, Moroes Curse and Reflection turn on; their first timers (10-16, 35-48 and 25 s) count from the drop below 50 percent because they do not tick above it. Shadow Blast is instant, so it cannot be kicked. Smoke Bomb comes first at 15-18 s and then every 15-18 s.
Smoke Bomb lands on a random player and silences everyone within its area around that player (implicit target 28, an area at the destination): spread out.

The director's-cut branch (teleport 12980, a second interlude and a 10 percent heal) is compiled out; the rows above are the health-based fight. Ghost Visual 9617 is applied directly every tick, with no cast event.

61939.name: Keeper Gnarlmoon
notes: Blood Boil 10 s, Flock of Ravens 15 s then 33 s, Blood Siphon 6-8 s and Lunar Shift 25 s come from creature_spells 619390, a one-line tw_world dump.
Ravens take damage only from players with Blue Moon (51080); the first half of the raid gets Red Moon (51081) and the rest Blue Moon at the pull, and Lunar Shift swaps the two and resets 100% threat.

66.6 and 33.3 percent: Worgen Dimension (51096) makes him immune to all attacks and spells, and two Blue plus two Red Owls spawn at fixed points with a 60 s timed despawn. The dimension ends only after four owl DEATHS, so owls not killed within 60 s despawn without counting and leave him immune.
51087 Owl Gaze is bound to an aura script but no tw_world creature or spell list casts it.

61946.name: Ley-Watcher Incantagos
notes: Summon Ley-Seeker (45-55 s), Summon Whelps (30-35 s), Ley-Line Disturbance (30 s) and Blizzard (14-17 s) start only after all four Ley-Seekers die; Gaze runs from the pull (7 s then 30-35 s), and Arcane Missiles and Guided Ley-Beam share one 8-12 s timer.
Every Ley-Line Disturbance summons one random Affinity; it dies 15 s later, and one still alive Berserks the boss (26662) first. Affinities are immune to every school but their own.
Below 40 percent Curse of Manascale is added every 13 s; the other abilities keep running.
Manascale Whelp 59955 is not in the current creature dump (the template has 59988 Manascale Whelp); the Ley-Seeker's own spells are 51175 Surge of Mana and 51177 Arcane Explosion.
While a Ley-Seeker lives it channels 51187 on the boss; each summoned Affinity channels it too.

61951.name: Anomalus
notes: Repeats are 15 s, 24 s and 9 s times max(30, health percent)/100, so they shorten as he dies (4.5, 7.2 and 2.7 s at 30 percent).

Overload, Unstable Magic and Prison walk the threat list and take the first eligible player: the highest-threat non-victim who has none of 51100, 51101 or 51107 (the data's t=random is the nearest label).
On overload expiry the player casts 51099 Arcane Bomb and 51101 Arcane Dampening on itself with Anomalus as the original caster.
Manabound Strikes 51105 is applied by the passive aura 51106 and 51098 pulses 51097 around the boss; neither has a cast event.
Unstable Magic Zone 59996 takes no damage and dies after 8 s, so nothing kills it (kill priority 0): it needs a soaker within 8 yd, or on death every player within 200 yd takes 51104.

61958.name: Echo of Medivh
notes: Six spells are picked at random (plus Shadow Bolt in shadowform, Shadebolt otherwise) and cast whenever the boss is not already casting; there is no timer. None is flagged interruptible: do not interrupt him.
Gaze of the Guardian is first cast 20-25 s after the pull, then every 20-25 s.
Do not interrupt him: every interrupt effect adds a Guardian's Ire stack, and 4 stacks cast Medivh's Fury.
At 80, 50 and 20 percent one Unstoppable Infernal is summoned; 50 percent adds Shadowform; 20 percent adds Enrage and Medivhs Fury.
While shadowformed a Shade of Medivh is summoned every 10 s; Shadow Bolt 51122 also summons one through its spell effect.
The Shade casts 24668 Shadow Bolt; the Infernal casts 51124 Charge of Flame then 51123 Pulse of Fire (creature_spells 599940 and 599950, one-line dumps).

59967.name: King
notes: When a Bishop, Rook or Knight dies the King casts Kings Fury 51229 on himself, and he removes Invulnerability 51228 when he is the only piece left.
Pawns Advance (51210, aura script) recalculates each pawns weapon damage from the number of nearby pawns every second.
Void Zone 28863 summons a persistent object (spell effect 41), a damaging area the schema cannot flag as ground.
The Kings creature template carries aura 51228 and spell list 599670, but there is no creature_spells row for 599670: every King cast comes from the script.
Summon Pawn is first cast 8-14 s after the pull and Kings Curse 40-50 s; both keep their random window afterward.

59971.name: Bishop
notes: Heal 51214 goes to a pawn below 75% health within 40 yd; Redemption 51216 only fires after the Knight is dead, on a dead Pawn within 40 yd (it brings it back to life); Silence 51217 only after the Rook is dead, on a random mana user.
Shadow Bolt is 51212 within 10 yd of the Bishop and Empowered Shadow Bolt 51213 beyond; Episcopacy 51218 is cast once the Bishop is the only piece left.

59970.name: Rook
notes: Fortify 51221 only fires after the Bishop is dead; Siege Equipment 51223 only after the Knight is dead; Shield Bash 51219 and Advance 51220 halve their repeats when the Rook is the only piece left.
Episcopacy 51218 is cast once the Rook is the only piece left.

59968.name: Knight

Knights Glory 51224 is cast at spawn; Episcopacy 51218 is cast once the Knight is the only piece left.

59981.name: Sanv Tas'dal

Opening the Rift also summons a Rift-Lost Draenei every second through 51208 (misc 59975).
The three portals are script summons at fixed points; each summons Rift-Lost, Shadow-Lost or Netherwalker every 7 s and a Riftwalker or Riftstalker every 30-50 s.
A Draenei Riftwalker casts 51199 on a friendly, turning it into a Rift Elemental 59974 and killing both.

59991.name: Kruul
notes: Mark of the Highlord goes to up to 3 random mana users; each tick casts 51165 Shadow Nova from the player with Kruul as the original caster.
Before 25 percent Mark repeats every 30 s and Call goes on the victim every 25 s; after 25 percent Mark is 15 s, Call 15 s on a random player and Void Bolt Volley 10 s.

notes: No script and no EventAI row or spell list exist for Karrsh; the template is EventAI with no creature_ai_events row and no spell ids. His mechanics were never recorded; the guide only says his health was raised. See the raid notes.

notes: The four spells are the template's spell_id1 to spell_id4 (52806 52813 52812 52808) and the AI is EventAI with no event rows; the core never casts them. No timer exists. Aura of Infection ticks every 2 s and Infected Secretion's pool every 1 s while it lasts.
Venomous Vines is a disease and Spores of Corruption a curse; Aura of Infection has no dispel. The guide calls him the poison-cloud boss but the data cannot confirm which spell that is.

62935.name: Ormanos the Cracked
notes: The five spells are name and description matches only; 49030 says Ormanos prepares to charge and 49029 says the damage depends on the charge. No EventAI row or spell list links them to the creature and no timer exists.
Tremors is a 200 nature per 2 s ground zone at a dynamic object; Rampaging Earth knocks the charge target back and the charge length scales the damage. The guide's stomp and soak have no spell id.

62940.name: Selenaxx Foulheart
notes: Name matches only; no EventAI rows and no timer. Foulheart Siphon drains mana and damages every 1 s; Curse of Foulheart is a 100 yd curse; the imp summon is a 1.5 s cast. The guide's stacking portal debuff has no spell id in the core.
The guide says about 40 imps spawn and that satyrs can be enslaved or killed without a wipe; no satyr spell or add count is in the core.

62946.name: Trioch the Devourer
notes: Corrosive and Frozen Spit leave an aura with dispel 0; the two Icicle Crash rows are instant point hits of 8 yd and 100 yd. The spells are matched by name and no EventAI row or timer exists.
34724 to 34727 are self head markers with no damage in the row; the head and fury damage lives in a script the core does not have. The guide's fire breath has no spell id.

62938.name: Archdruid Kronn
notes: Ultimate Sacrifice 34779 heals Kronn but its caster is an ally; Reform Body 34780 and Return to Body 34781 are the form swap. No EventAI rows and no timers exist.

60699.name: Dreamform of Kronn
notes: Dreamform of Kronn 60699 is a creature template only: rank 3 and 210000 hp with EventAI and no spell ids. The creature table has no spawn row for it and no script or creature_ai_events row exists so the form Kronn swaps into is never created by the core.

62941.name: Chieftain Partath
notes: Name matches only; no EventAI rows and no timers. 52789 is an add's shield and 52800 with 52799 is the totem's pulse and its Seeping Mass summon; their caster is not Partath so they are kept out of the ability rows.
The core template is faction 370 (friendly to players); the plan says 915 is needed and the guide says a guild killed him. Adds did not respawn after a reset in the guide.

60747.name: Erennius
notes: Wall of Erennius (the client name is Wail of Erennius) and Green Dragon Binding only tick while Solnius is alive and in combat, so in the normal order Erennius is fought alone while Solnius is neutral and casts neither; both start once Solnius is pulled with Erennius alive. The Binding is cast on Solnius, not on a player.
Curse of Erennius is cast once; 81-92 s after Erennius drops below 50 percent; on his current victim.
Poison Bolt Volley's first cast comes at 9-13 s and repeats every 9-13 s; Howl repeats every 30-33 s.
Erennius joins the pull when Solnius is engaged; if Solnius dies first while Erennius is in combat, Erennius drops the fight, goes passive and despawns after 20 s.

60748.name: Solnius
notes: Emerald Rot: one timer; 15 s to 8 random players in phase 1; it freezes in phase 2 above 40 percent and then runs every 30 s to 4 random players; it is reset to 30 s when Solnius wakes. It is an area effect: every enemy within 20 yd of Solnius gets it (targets 22/15, radius 9); the named players are only the cast targets.

The four gimmick debuffs share one 27 s timer and are triggered casts with no cast time; phase 2 only. Bane of Eranikus is an area at Solnius (targets 18/16, triggered so the destination is the caster), so it hits every enemy within 20 yd of him; the two random players are only its cast targets. Sanctum Mind Decay, Dreamfever and Emerald Instability land on their chosen players (implicit target A=6), 2 random players each.

Solnius transforms once at the first check at least 12 s after the pull while below 90 percent; until then he stays in phase 1 whatever the damage, so a burst below 90 percent inside the first 12 s shows phase 2 at the 12 s mark. The threat list is wiped; a random player gets 10 threat; taunt and attack-me become immune; he never returns to phase 1.

Solnius sleeps once; 12 s after the transform and only below 60 percent; 45 s sleep. He is untargetable and passive, but the phase stays phase 2 and the threat list is kept, so by the code he can keep casting Acid Breath and the gimmicks during it (not seen live); the Emerald Rot timer restarts at 30 s on waking; more than 50 yd from home he is teleported home first.

Portals open 5 s after the sleep: three fixed portals; each spawns a random major (Dragonkin, Wyrmkin, Scalebane or Suppressor) and a Dreamer; two more Dreamers every 30 s at portals 1 and 3 while a major lives; the portals close when all majors are dead.

Hard mode: Solnius pulls Erennius when he is engaged while Erennius lives, and only then does Expulsion of Corruption run; Solnius's pull also sends every trash creature the instance registered at the player who pulled him.
Solnius cannot be attacked until a player picks the gossip option (menu 92950); that clears the untargetable flag and sets faction 14.
When Solnius dies while Erennius is alive and in combat; Erennius resets threat, goes passive and despawns after 20 s, and a chest appears at 3276.2, 3043.9.

The portal majors and Dreamers each have their own boss block in this table (60742, 60743, 60745, 60746, 61212) with the timers from their scripts; they stay Solnius's adds, so kill priority stays on the add rows here.
The Sanctum Wyrm 60744 is ordinary trash, and Solnius's pull sends it at the player who pulled him along with every other trash creature the instance still has registered.

60745.name: Sanctum Wyrmkin

60746.name: Sanctum Scalebane
notes: Scalebane Intimidation is an area at the scalebane (implicit targets 22, radius 10 = 30 yd); Cleave is a melee strike on the current victim.

9018.name: High Interrogator Gerstahn

9016.name: Bael'Gar
notes: Bael'Gar has no boss script: EventAI runs four HP events that cast 13895 at 82, 62, 42 and 22 percent, each a cast-time spell at a random attacker that summons one Spawn of Bael'Gar where that player stands, plus his creature_spells list 90160, Magma Splash 13880 at his current victim every 10-14 s (first 8-12). The 13895 cast is not kickable (preventionType 0) and its timer columns are 0 because the events are HP thresholds.

9033.name: General Angerforge
notes: The first Sunder is 5-10 s after the pull; the alarm fires as soon as he drops below 30 percent and again every 3 minutes while he stays below it, summoning eight Anvilrage Reservists and two Anvilrage Medics at the m_aAddspawnLocs points for 30 s.

8894.name: Anvilrage Medic

8983.name: Golem Lord Argelmach
notes: Lightning Shield is re-applied whenever it is missing; its 15 s timer only limits the retry after the aura drops, and his ai_name EventAI never runs because the script_name npc_golem_lord_argelmach wins.
On aggro he walks to 846.801, 16.281, -53.640 and pulls the living Ragereaver Golems and Wrath Hammer Constructs within 80 yd onto his current victim.

9017.name: Lord Incendius
notes: Lord Incendius has no ai_name, script_name or EventAI row, but his creature_spells list 90170 runs under the default AggressorAI: Curse of the Elemental Lord 26977 on the raid every 20-28 s (first 1-5), Fiery Burst 13900 at his current victim every 9-16 s (first 6-11), Mighty Blow 14099 at a random attacker every 18-24 s (first 9-17) and Fire Storm 13899 at a random attacker every 11-14 s (first 12-16).

9056.name: Fineous Darkvire
notes: Fineous Darkvire has no boss script: EventAI casts Devotion Aura on himself after 1 s and every 4 minutes, Holy Strike at his current target every 6-8.5 s while it is within 5 yd (first at the pull), Holy Light on himself at 60 and again at 40 percent, and Seal of Reckoning at 20 percent; his creature_spells list 90560 casts Kick 11978 at his current victim every 11-15 s (first at the pull), which interrupts that player's cast. Holy Light is the only kickable cast.

9156.name: Ambassador Flamelash
notes: Ambassador Flamelash has no boss script: his EventAI only switches the instance encounter, and the instance opens the seven dwarf runes and summons a Burning Spirit at each one every 15-30 s (5 s for the first), up to 30, which follow him. He casts 14744 on himself whenever a spirit's 13489 hits him.

9938.name: Magmus
notes: War Stomp starts below 51 percent with a timer of 0, so the first one lands on the next update; Fiery Burst is a 10 yd area at his current victim.

9019.name: Emperor Dagran Thaurissan
notes: Hand of Thaurissan is cast only while a player other than the top threat is alive; its first window is 5-7.5 s and a failed cast leaves the timer at 0 and retries every update.
Princess Moira Bronzebeard 8929 fights with him, heals him with 15586 whenever he is not at full health and turns friendly when he dies; she is an add row here, not a block of this table.
Ironfoe 15642 is defined in his script but never cast.

9196.name: Highlord Omokk
notes: He evades when pulled by a pet or when his z leaves 25 to 50; the enrage his comment asks about is not cast.

9236.name: Shadow Hunter Vosh'gajin
notes: Hex adds 15 s to its own timer after a successful cast instead of resetting it; he evades when pulled by a pet or when his z leaves 0 to 30.

9237.name: War Master Voone
notes: Throw Axe stops after the second hit: the second applies the passive 16076 and the loop ends; the first throw is 10-30 s after the pull and repeats are 5-15 s.

10596.name: Mother Smolderweb

9736.name: Quartermaster Zigris

10220.name: Halycon
notes: Gizrul the Slavener spawns when she dies through a direct SummonCreature at -167.58, -382.41, 64.401 and sets his home to -172.633, -324.253, 64.401; no spell is involved.

10268.name: Gizrul the Slavener
notes: Gizrul the Slavener spawns when Halycon dies and fights with creature_spells list 102680: Fatal Bite 16495 at his current victim every 7-15 s (first 7-15) and Infected Bite 16128 every 10-20 s (first 15-20), a disease that also raises the physical damage its target takes; EventAI 1026801 casts Enrage 8269 below 20 percent and repeats it every 30 s while he stays below.

9568.name: Overlord Wyrmthalak
notes: Below 51 percent he summons one Spirestone Warlord and one Smoldertooth Berserker once, at the two afLocations points; he evades when pulled by a pet or when his z leaves 72 to 100.

9216.name: Spirestone Warlord

His EventAI 921602 is named Frenzy at 30 percent but its only action is a text line.

9268.name: Smolderthorn Berserker
notes: The Smolderthorn Berserker is summoned by Wyrmthalak below 51 percent; his creature_spells list 92680 casts Strike 13446 at his current victim every 4-6 s (first 5-7) and Mortal Strike 17547 every 6-10 s (first 5), which cuts the victim's healing taken for 28 s and cannot be dispelled. His EventAI 926801 is named Frenzy at 30 percent but its only action is a text line.

8127.name: Antu'sul
notes: Earthgrab Totem 8376 and Healing Ward 11899 share one EventAI timer: the first at 11.6 s, then every 13.3-21.7 s, one of the two chosen at random.
Four Sul'lithuz Broodlings 8138 spawn 3 s after the pull from four script summon commands; the three Hatchlings 8130 by his spawn are not attackable and are not adds.

creature_spells 81270 stores seconds: Fire Nova Totem 11314 first 7-11 s then every 10-13 s; Earth Shock 10413 first and every 7 s. Only one due spell is cast per 1.2 s update.

8156.name: Servant of Antu'sul
notes: creature_spells 81560 stores seconds: Petrify 11020 first 5-16 s then every 22-36 s on the victim; it stuns and is magic, so it can be dispelled.
Antu'sul summons one servant at 75 percent and two at 25 percent; the servant is faction 107, joins the fight and is killed first.

7272.name: Theka the Martyr
notes: creature_spells 72720 stores seconds: Fevered Plague 8600 first 15-18 s then every 10-22 s, only when the target has no Fevered Plague aura; the plague is a disease.

notes: creature_spells 77950 stores seconds: Healing Wave 12491 every 9-22 s from the pull; Ward of Zum'rah 11086 first 2-5 s then every 13-28 s; Shadow Bolt Volley 15245 first 5-10 s then every 17-22 s; Shadow Bolt 12739 every 2 s at 90 percent chance.

notes: creature_spells 72710 stores seconds: Shadow Bolt 12739 every 3-5 s on a random player; Shadow Bolt Volley 15245 first 6-30 s then every 10-18 s; Ward of Zum'rah 11086 first 7-20 s then every 15-32 s; Healing Wave 12491 first 10-15 s then every 15-23 s on the most injured friendly below 40 percent.

notes: creature_spells 76060 stores seconds: Rain of Fire 11990 first 8-10 s then every 15-20 s at 80 percent chance; Immolate 11962 first 5-7 s then every 23-27 s at 80 percent; Curse of Weakness 12741 once at the pull then every 120 s; Shadow Bolt 9613 every 2 s. He is killed first.

7267.name: Chief Ukorz Sandscalp
notes: creature_spells 72670 stores seconds: Berserker Stance 7366 first 0-3 s then every 240-245 s; Cleave 15496 first 6-20 s then every 8-19 s; Wide Slash 11837 first 12-16 s then every 7-24 s.

Ruuzlu 7797 cleaves and executes a target below 20 percent; kill him first.

7274.name: Sandfury Executioner
notes: creature_spells 72740 stores seconds: Berserker Stance 7366 first 0-3 s then every 243 s; Cleave 15496 first 7-13 s then every 7-23 s.

7275.name: Shadowpriest Sezz'ziz
notes: Wave 3 spawns her with Nekrum Gutchewer 7796 and five Sandfury adds at the foot of the stairs; Nekrum is melee and dies first. She flees at 15 percent.

creature_spells 72750 stores seconds: Psychic Scream 13704 first 11-16 s then every 22-32 s; Heal 12039 every 14-25 s; Renew 8362 every 28-35 s; Shadow Bolt 15537 is listed twice, every 2-4 s either only in melee at 50 percent chance or only out of melee.

8580.name: Atal'alarion
notes: He is invisible and unselectable until the six Atal'ai statues are used in the order 148830, 148831, 148832, 148833, 148834, 148835; a wrong statue triggers a trap.
creature_spells 85800 stores seconds: Sweeping Slam 12887 first 10-14 s then every 21-41 s; Ground Tremor 6524 first 9-18 s then every 20-32 s. Ground Tremor stuns everything within 20 yd.

Sweeping Slam is a 120 degree front cone (target 24); its radius index is 8 and no local SpellRadius.dbc gives the reach, so it has no shape row yet. The statue positions are -515.6 95.3, -419.8 94.5, -491.4 136.0, -491.5 53.5, -443.9 136.1 and -443.4 53.8 at z -148.7.

5720.name: Weaver
notes: creature_spells 57200 stores seconds: Acid Breath 12884 first 2-6 s then every 6-21 s; Wing Flap 12882 first 8-13 s then every 19-34 s. Both are 120 degree front cones of 10 yd; Wing Flap knocks targets back.
She is invisible and unselectable until Jammal'an dies.

5721.name: Dreamscythe
notes: creature_spells 57210 stores seconds: Acid Breath 12884 first 2-6 s then every 8-17 s; Wing Flap 12882 first 8-13 s then every 19-34 s. Both are 120 degree front cones of 10 yd; Wing Flap knocks targets back.
She is invisible and unselectable until Jammal'an dies, then walks the room on waypoints.

5710.name: Jammal'an the Prophet
notes: creature_spells 57100 stores seconds: Flamestrike 12468 first 10-15 s then every 10-15 s on a random player; Earthgrab Totem 8376 first and every 8-15 s.

Hex of Jammal'an 12479 is a 10 s dummy on a random player; when it ends the player casts 12480 on themselves (transform plus damage modifier, a curse): decurse after it turns into 12480. Healing Wave 12492 has two independent EventAI timers: the most injured friendly within 40 yd every 3-10 s from the pull, and himself below 80 percent every 5-15 s. Green Channeling 13540 is out of combat only and removed on aggro.

When Jammal'an enters combat the instance sets every Mummified Atal'ai 5263, Deathwalker 5271 and High Priest 5273 within 150 yd in combat; Ogom the Wretched 5711 is not in that list and joins on his own aggro.

5711.name: Ogom the Wretched
notes: creature_spells 57110 stores seconds: Curse of Weakness 12493 first 54-55 s then every 20-26 s on a random player; Shadow Word: Pain 11639 first 9-15 s then every 38-58 s on a random player; Shadow Bolt 12471 every 2 s on the victim.
He spawns in Jammal'an's room (guid 39827) but the room aggro does not pull him; he joins on his own aggro.

5719.name: Morphaz
notes: creature_spells 57190 stores seconds: Acid Breath 12884 first 2-6 s then every 8-17 s; Wing Flap 12882 first 8-13 s then every 19-34 s. Both are 120 degree front cones of 10 yd; Wing Flap knocks targets back.
He is invisible and unselectable until Jammal'an dies; Hazzas 5722 is killed first.

5722.name: Hazzas
notes: creature_spells 57220 stores seconds: Acid Breath 12884 first 2-6 s then every 8-17 s; Wing Flap 12882 first 8-13 s then every 19-34 s. Both are 120 degree front cones of 10 yd and are instant, so the panel draws no cast or arc.
Hazzas is Morphaz's kill-first add and casts the same two breaths; Wing Flap knocks targets back.

5709.name: Shade of Eranikus
notes: He sleeps and is unselectable until Jammal'an dies. Deep Slumber 12890 first 5-6 s then every 20-25 s on a random player; War Stomp 11876 fires once on the first combat tick; Thrash 3391 is a 10 percent extra-attack proc.
Nightmare Scalebanes 5277, Wyrmkin 5280, Whelps 8319 and Wanderers 5283 within 300 yd are set in combat with him; Deep Slumber is a magic sleep.

9816.name: Pyroguard Emberseer
notes: The cage is the first phase: Emberseer is unselectable and immune until every Blackhand Incarcerator within 35 yd is dead, then he removes the cage and casts 16047 and 16048. There is no pull timer: Fire Nova first lands 6 s after he is freed, Flame Buffet 3 s and Pyro Blast 14 s, and the repeats run from each cast.
Pyro Blast's timer adds 15 s to whatever was left, whether or not the cast succeeded, so a failed attempt waits that window instead of retrying on the next tick; a late cast shortens the next gap.
The Incarcerators cast 16045 Encage on a random player in line of sight and then Strike; those are add casts, not Emberseer's.

10429.name: Warchief Rend Blackhand
notes: Gyth is summoned by the instance and his EventAI summons Rend below 20% HP; Rend's timers start at that summon. creature_spells stores 20/18, 9/16 and 5/10 s and the list casts at most one due spell per 1.2 s update.
Enrage 8269 is a passive self aura, so the panel sees the HP crossing and no cast event.

10339.name: Gyth
notes: Gyth has no boss AI: the default AggressorAI runs his creature_spells list 103390, at most one due spell per 1.2 s update, and the stored timers count from when he engages. creature_spells 103390 stores seconds: Corrosive Acid Breath 16359 first 8 s then every 7 s, Freeze 16350 first 11 s then every 16 s, Flame Breath 16390 first 4 s then every 10 s, Knock Away 10101 first and every 23 s.
Flame Breath 16390 is a 2 s cast and a 120-degree 20 yd front cone in the shape table; Corrosive Acid Breath 16359 and Freeze 16350 are instant 20 yd cones and draw no shape.
Chromatic Chaos 16337 is not on Gyth's spell list: his 50% EventAI event (1033901) runs script 1033901, which casts it at Lord Victor Nefarius 10162.

10430.name: The Beast
notes: Flamebreak damages and knocks back everything within 10 yd; Berserker Charge knocks its target back. Flamebreak's first window is 8-12 s and Fire Blast's 8-11 s; afterward both are 14-20 s. The first Berserker Charge picks the current victim because the timer is 0 when the fight starts; later ones pick a random target that is not the tank, and a failed cast leaves the timer at 0 and retries every tick.
Immolate 15506 is re-applied whenever it is missing and is passive, so it has no cast event.

The script's Fire Blast constant is 14144, but spell_template 14144 is Remorseless Attacks and its only effect applies the aura to the caster; it arms a proc on the Beast, not fire damage on the target.
He evades when pulled by a pet or when he leaves z 75 to 125; skinning him casts 16710 and summons Finkle Einhorn 10776, which is not a combat add.

10363.name: General Drakkisath
notes: There is no boss script: the default AggressorAI uses creature_spells 103630. First casts are the stored random windows (8-40, 7-20, 7-40, 9-20, 0-5 and 8-20 s), repeats 10-30, 14-25, 8-35, 10-35, 30-60 and 15-45 s, and only one due spell is cast per 1.2 s update.

Flamestrike is the only cast-time spell (index 20, interrupt flags 15); the other five are instant. Rage 16789 is a passive self aura with no cast event. Conflagration confuses and burns the current victim; Flamestrike leaves a ground area.

16042.name: Lord Valthalak
notes: Shadow Wrath's first cast is 8-12 s after the pull and then every 8-12 s, in phase 1 only: its EventAI row skips phases 2 and 3, so it stops in phase 2 like Summon Spectral Assassin.

EventAI phases: 1 on aggro, 2 below 40% (casts Enrage 8269) and 3 below 15%. Summon Spectral Assassin and Shadow Wrath stop in phase 2; the phase-3 loops cast Shadow Bolt Volley and Enrage only while those auras are missing.
Enrage 8269 is passive, so it cannot signal a phase; the phase rows are HP thresholds and phase 3 outranks phase 2.
Shadow Bolt Volley 27382 is a self aura that pulses 27383 at nearby players every 2 s; the cast is instant and has no cast bar.
Spirit of Lord Valthalak 16073 is summoned on death at 44.71/-536/110, not during the fight.

10505.name: Instructor Malicia
notes: Flash Heal is a three-cast cycle: first at 22 s, then 5 s, 5 s and a 30 s rest; the 5-30 s repeat window is that cycle. Healing Touch repeats every 30 s after 25 s: the 5.5 s branch tests the timer after it has fired, so it almost never runs.
Call of the Grave is centred on Malicia even though the cast passes the victim (implicit target 22 + 15).

11261.name: Doctor Theolen Krastinov
notes: Backhand also resets the victim's threat by 100 percent. Enrage starts 1 s after he drops below 26 percent and re-casts every 120 s; the aura is the phase.

10901.name: Lorekeeper Polkelt
notes: Dark Plague is applied on aggro and is not a phase. Corrosive Acid is centred on Polkelt even though the cast passes the victim.

10507.name: The Ravenian
notes: Trample is centred on Ravenian; Knock Away knocks the victim back.

10504.name: Lord Alexei Barov
notes: Veil of Shadow is centred on Alexei even though the cast passes the victim.

10502.name: Lady Illucia Barov
notes: Curse of Agony and Shadow Shock are centred on Illucia even though the casts pass a target.

10503.name: Jandice Barov
notes: Curse of Blood is centred on Jandice. Every 15 s she vanishes for 3 s (faction 35, friendly, not selectable, threat -99 percent) and spawns 10 Illusions of Jandice at once; UpdateAI returns while she is invisible, so the next illusion is 25 s after she reappears. After she reappears, more than 500 damage to her despawns every illusion. While invisible she is friendly and leaves the panel.
The script defines Banish 8994, Summon Illusions 17773 and Phasing 16122 but never casts them.

11622.name: Rattlegore
notes: Rattlegore has no script; creature_spells list 116220 gives Knock Away first 7-12 s then 10-17 s, Strike first 6-11 s then 7-11 s, and War Stomp first 15-21 s then 13-19 s. Timers are seconds in one dump line, so the columns are 0. War Stomp is centred on him.

10432.name: Vectus
notes: Flamestrike lands on Vectus; Blast Wave is centred on him. His first victim makes every student within 100 yd attack the raid, and one student's aggro turns the whole room hostile: every student, Marduk and Vectus. All 32 students stand within 100 yd. The optional Dawn's Gambit also turns Marduk and every student hostile, transforms the students and sets Vectus to 888 health.

10433.name: Marduk Blackpool
notes: creature_spells list 104330: Shadow Bolt Volley first 5-8 s then 6-14 s, Cleave first 15-17 s then 7-22 s, Shadow Shield first 14-15 s then 1-8 s; timers are seconds in one dump line, so the columns are 0. Shadow Shield is a self aura. Defiling Aura is cast on aggro (EventAI 1043302) and is a self aura.

10508.name: Ras Frostwhisper
notes: Fear, Chill Nova and Frostbolt Volley are centred on Ras even though the casts pass the victim.

1853.name: Darkmaster Gandling
notes: Summoned once all six room bosses are done. Every 16 s, then every 20-35 s, he casts Shadow Portal on a random attacker: 2 s later the player loses 100 percent threat, is teleported into one of the six rooms and 3-4 Risen Guards spawn with a 10-15 s despawn; the room gate is closed while they live and opens when the last dies. He stops teleporting below 3 percent health. Arcane Missiles is a channel the core can interrupt.

10506.name: Kirtonos the Herald
notes: Summoned by the Blood of Innocents at the brazier; the gate closes during the fight. creature_spells list 105060: Swoop first 8 s then 15 s, Wing Flap 15 s then 13 s, Pierce Armor 18 s then 12 s, Disarm 22 s then 11 s, Shadow Bolt Volley 42 s, Curse of Tongues 53 s then 35 s, Dominate Mind 34-48 s then 44-48 s. EventAI changes his form 16-18 s into the fight and every 22 s after (Kirtonos Transform 16467, equipment 11365).

16118.name: Kormok
notes: creature_spells list 161180: Summon Bone Minion first 10-15 s then 10-15 s, Shadow Bolt Volley first 8-10 s then 8-12 s. EventAI recasts Bone Shield whenever it is missing (first at the pull, then 20-25 s), summons a Bone Mage at 49-51 percent and again at 24-26 percent, enrages below 20 percent, takes the Dungeon Set 2 ghost look on spawn and loses aura immunity on aggro. Timers are seconds in one dump line, so the columns are 0. The unused boss_kormok.cpp is not attached to the entry.

14695.name: Lord Blackwood
notes: Lord Blackwood patrols the Viewing Room in a square and only uses Multi-Shot while the victim is out of melee reach; Shield Bash is on a fixed 8 s timer.

10435.name: Magistrate Barthilas
notes: Crowd Pummel is centred on Barthilas. Furious Anger stacks at most 26 times (AngerCount > 25) and the timer keeps running afterward. Barthilas stays untargetable until a player comes within 10 yd.

10437.name: Nerub'enkan
notes: Encasing Webs removes the victim's threat and re-adds it when the web aura ends. Raise Undead Scarab is a direct spawn, not a cast: first 3 s then 6-10 s; a random target gets either 4, 6 or 8 Crypt Scarabs 10577 or one Undead Scarab 10876. Spell 17235 is defined but never cast.

10438.name: Maleki the Pallid
notes: Drain Life and Drain Mana share one timer: first 4 s, then 12-18 s, only while Maleki is below 60 percent health or 50 percent mana; Drain Mana if the victim has mana, else Drain Life. Ice Tomb also removes the victim's threat until the aura ends.

10436.name: Baroness Anastari
notes: Banshee Curse and Silence are centred on Anastari. Possess takes a random player above 30 percent health, teleports her onto them and makes her invisible and not selectable while she controls them; she returns when the aura ends or the player drops below 25 percent and the next possess is 13-18 s after the return. The panel loses her while invisible.

10440.name: Baron Rivendare
notes: creature_spells list 104400: Shadow Bolt first 5 s then 10 s, Cleave first 8 s then 7-17 s, Mortal Strike first 12 s then 10-25 s, Raise Dead first 15 s then every 15 s. Timers are seconds in one dump line, so the columns are 0. Each Raise Dead casts 17475-17480, six Mindless Skeletons. Five Black Guard Sentries are spawned by the Slaughter Square timer before the fight, not by a spell; Rivendare is untargetable until Ramstein is done.

10811.name: Archivist Galford
notes: Fire Nova from creature_spells list 108110: first 7-12 s, repeat 7-12 s, centred on Galford; timers are seconds in one dump line, so the columns are 0. Pyroblast is cast once on aggro. Burning Winds is a repeating in-combat cast (13-16 s first, then 15-18 s) that also drops the victim's threat by 100 percent.

10812.name: Grand Crusader Dathrohan
notes: At 40 percent he casts Balnazzar Transform, becomes entry 10813 and is stunned for 4 s; the transform heals him to full and the human abilities stop. Mind Blast carries the same timer in both forms. The demon abilities, the death summons and the demon phase live in the 10813 block because the panel looks up the live entry.

10813.name: Balnazzar
notes: The transform heals him to full, so this block has no health rule. The demon timers start after the 4 s stun, so their columns are 0: Shadow Shock 3 s then 11 s, Psychic Scream 12 s then 20 s, Sleep 9 s then 15 s, Domination 18 s then 25-30 s. Mind Blast carries the same timer from the human form. On death he summons 32 skeletons at fixed points, random Skeletal Berserker or Skeletal Guardian.

10997.name: Cannon Master Willey
notes: Knock Away is first at 15-20 s then 15-20 s, Pummel first at 5-10 s then 12 s; the first values are random, so a is 0. Summon Rifleman is first 5 s then every 10 s, three Crimson Riflemen at once from nine fixed points, 4 min lifetime. The gate closes on aggro.

10439.name: Ramstein the Gorger
notes: Spawned once every pre-placed Bile Spewer and Venom Belcher is dead. The abominations walk to him one at a time after he aggros (first after 20 s, then every 35-45 s). He gates Rivendare: the Baron stays not selectable until Ramstein dies. His death opens the Slaughter Square gate and spawns 34 Mindless Undead. Knockout drops the victim's threat by 100 percent.

11143.name: Postmaster Malown
notes: Summoned by the third postbox: opening it while the instance is special casts Summon Postmaster Malown 24627, and three Undead Postmen spawn at every postbox. Cast chances: Wailing Dead 65 percent, Backhand 45 percent, Curse of Weakness and Curse of Tongues 3 percent, Call of the Grave 5 percent.

10808.name: Timmy the Cruel
notes: Spawned by the Crimson Guardsman with DB GUID 54070 when it dies. He despawns with his corpse.

14684.name: Balzaphon
notes: creature_spells list 146840: Frostbolt first 1-4 s then 2-4 s; timers are seconds in one dump line, so the columns are 0. At 30 percent health he fears his current victim once.
